implementation.route: A normal Japanese Engine chain commits a premise, an alternate-query input at version 2, explicit-query versions 1 and 2, AskPreviousRelation anchored to explicit-query version 2, then ExplainPrevious to a permissioned temporary fixture target. After Engine reopen, Recovery inspect accepts the valid saved result.
implementation.anchor_input_id_test: In a cloned CaseRevision, only the direct anchor input_id changes from explicit-query to alternate-query. The alternate sealed input exists for the same actor/case and input_version 2, with the same question text but a distinct request identity. Recovery rejects the identity mismatch with RECOVERY_CONTEXT_PROOF_CHANGED.
implementation.current_head_index: The existing B84 Store::get_input_bundle binding guard is unchanged; this test verifies its identity-equality check after a successful lookup of a different existing sealed input.
implementation.cold_or_stale_index: Not newly exercised by B86; the existing authenticated fallback remains unchanged.
implementation.retained_revision_replay: The valid saved route passes Recovery inspect after Engine reopen. The negative input_id change exists only in a cloned CaseRevision; the persisted latest revision and output bytes remain unchanged.
preserved_contracts: Both explicit-query and alternate-query version-2 sealed inputs exist under the same actor and case.
The anchor map key, ResultRecord.id, COMMIT lifecycle and input_version stay unchanged; only input_id changes.
A successful lookup of another sealed request cannot rebind the committed anchor because identity(request) differs from anchor.id.
No production code, API, schema, dependency, manifest or lockfile changes.
implementation.change_type: One Engine library regression test only.
implementation.runtime_verification_scope: One saved AskPreviousRelation -> ExplainPrevious Recovery consumer; malformed anchor is a cloned CaseRevision only, not persistent Store corruption or repair.
